Name: Entry
Desc: A weathered stone archway marks the beginning of your journey.

Name: Old Oak Tree
Desc: A massive ancient oak stands here

Name: The Great Way
Desc: A wide, cobbled road stretches onward, worn smooth by centuries of travelers

Name: The Hollow
Desc: Where it all begins and ends

Name: Whispering Woods
Desc: Twisted trees lean close together, murmuring secrets in a language you almost understand

Name: Crystal Caves
Desc: Jagged crystals jut from every wall, refracting light into a thousand fractured colors

Name: Dragon's Domain
Desc: Scorched stone and enormous claw marks hint at something far too large to fight

Name: Mushroom Meadows
Desc: Glowing mushrooms carpet the field, pulsing faintly with bioluminescent light

Name: Mystic Mountains
Desc: Jagged peaks vanish into swirling mist, humming faintly with old magic

Name: Clockwork City
Desc: Brass gears the size of houses turn endlessly, powering a city that never sleeps

Name: Frozen Fjord
Desc: Ice-locked cliffs plunge into black water, silent except for the crack of shifting glaciers

Name: Paradise Shore
Desc: White sand meets turquoise water beneath a sky that never seems to storm

Name: Pirate's Bay
Desc: Wrecked ships litter the harbor, their masts jutting like skeletal fingers from the surf

Name: Haunted Graves
Desc: Rows of cracked headstones lean at odd angles under a sky that's always dusk

Name: Molten Ranges
Desc: Rivers of lava carve glowing veins through blackened volcanic rock

Name: Abandoned City
Desc: Crumbling towers and empty streets echo with the memory of a civilization long gone

Name: Box Room
Desc: Stacks of boxes fill the space, daring you to guess what's inside

Name: Frozen Wasteland
Desc: An endless plain of ice stretches to the horizon under a pale, sunless sky

Name: Hidden Room
Desc: A secret chamber

Name: The Arid Drylands
Desc: Cracked earth stretches for miles, baked hard under a merciless sun

Name: Desert
Desc: Endless dunes ripple outward, shifting slowly with the wind
